about: The witnesses of the reference values: packages that compute the same numbers outside Tabularia, run by hand by make_witness.R in a scratch library with GSL (docs/specs/customer-lifetime-models.md, «Reference values»). Never installed in the group's image; not part of the recipe, so changing them builds nothing.
r: BTYDplus@1.2.0 (archived by CRAN on 2025-06-13: installed from the CRAN Archive)
hypergeo@1.2-15 (the second witness of GSL's 2F1, where z is at most 0.5; the first is the Gauss series, whose terms are all positive for 0 <= z < 1)
